About Organization

The Institute of Banking and Personal Selection (IBPS) is a recruitment body that conducts exams for various banks in India.

IBPS is responsible for recruiting candidates for public sector banks, regional rural banks, and other financial institutions.

About the Programme

The IBPS PO 16th Recruitment 2026 is a national-level exam conducted by IBPS to recruit candidates for the post of Probationary Officer (PO) and Management Trainee (MT) in various banks.

The exam is conducted to select candidates who can work in the banking sector and contribute to the growth of the Indian economy.
